retention_policy: No family, trade, day, or source row is rejected because a measurement is missing. Original source database and payloads remain pinned.
rerun_status: paused at user request pending disclosure of remaining gaps
unrecoverable_or_ineligible_categories: source-defined measurement states, including NO_FLOW, SIDE_UNDEFINED, NOT_F_LAST and other recorded reasons
explicit null or unmaterialized measurement keys in the pinned payload
external observation absent or not yet published at cutoff; no future backfill
price endpoint before first or after last retained trade, or stale observation age
registry roles whose disposition is control/identity/not-read rather than a numerical measurement
